40011543.content: सर्वत्र all over, प्रदृश्यमानः he appeared, मारुतात्मजः son of Windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, लम्बपक्षः longwinged, अद्रिराट् इव like king of mountains, निरालम्बम्  unsupported, अम्बरम् the sky, भेजे occupied.

40011543.author: Translation
40011543.content: Hanuman, son of the Windgod was seen everywhere in the sky. He appeared like a longwinged king of mountains unsupported.

40011544.author: पदार्थः
40011544.content: कामरूपिणी who can take any form at will, सिंहिका नाम called Simhika, राक्षसी demoness, प्लवमानम् him who was speeding in the sky, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, प्रवृद्धा expanded in size, चिन्तयामास started thinking.

40011544.author: Translation
40011544.content: Seeing Hanuman speeding in the sky a demoness called Simhika who can assume any form at her will had grown out of proportion and thought on her part:

40011545.author: पदार्थः
40011545.content: चिरस्य after a long time, इदम् this, महत् great, सत्त्वम् being, मे my, वशम् fold, आगतम् has come, दीर्घस्य after a long, कालस्य time, अद्य today, अहम् I, आशिता satiated, भविष्यामि I will be.

40011545.author: Translation
40011545.content: After so long a time this great being has at last come within my power, and today I shall be satisfied.

40011546.author: पदार्थः
40011546.content: इति thus, मनसा in her mind, सञ्चिन्त्य after thinking, अस्य his, छायाम् shadow, समाक्षिपत् pulled, छायायाम् when his shadow, गृह्यमाणायाम् was held, वानरः vanara, चिन्तयामास deliberated.

40011546.author: Translation
40011546.content: Thinking thus, she dragged him by his shadow before she took hold of him, Hanuman started deliberating within.

40011547.author: पदार्थः
40011547.content: सागरे in the ocean, प्रतिलोमेन from the opposite side, वातेन by the wind, महानौरिव like a huge ship, पङ्गूकृतपराक्रमः  powerless, सहसा  suddenly, समाक्षिप्तः caught, अस्मि I am.

40011547.author: Translation
40011547.content: "I am caught suddenly. I am handicapped.I am like a huge ship in an ocean retarded by the wind blowing from the opposite direction.

40011548.author: पदार्थः
40011548.content: ततः then, कपिः monkey, तिर्यक् horizontally, ऊर्द्वम् upward, अथश्चैव at the bottom level, वीक्षमाणः while looking at, लवणाम्भसि in the salt sea, उत्थितम् risen up, महत् huge, सत्त्वम् being, ददर्श saw.

40011548.author: Translation
40011548.content: Looking around, right and left, up and down, the monkey saw a huge being rise from the salty sea.

40011549.author: पदार्थः
40011549.content: मारुतिः Maruti, विकृताननम् hideous countenance, तत् that creature, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, चिन्तयामास reflected, कपिराजेन by the king of monkeys, कथितम् described, अद्भुतदर्शनम् of wonderful appearance, छायाग्राहि  which can hold the shadow, महावीर्यम् very powerful, तत् that, सत्त्वम् creature, इदम् this, अत्र here it is, संशयः doubt, न no.

40011549.author: Translation
40011549.content: Seeing the form with a hideous countenance, Hanuman reflected about the creature of ugly appearance endowed with power which can catch a creature though his shadow, about which king Sugriva had once told him. 'It is the same creature, no doubt', said Hanuman.

40011550.author: पदार्थः
40011550.content: मतिमान् wise one, सः कपिः Hanuman, ताम् her, अर्थतत्त्वेन by her true nature, सिंहिकाम् Simhika, बुद्ध्वा recognising, महाकायः huge bodied one, प्रावृषि in rainy season, वलाहकः इव like a cloud, व्यवर्धत grew.

40011550.author: Translation
40011550.content: Recognising the true nature of Simhika the clutcher of shadows, the wise Hanuman grew to a huge size like a cloud in rainy season.

40011551.author: पदार्थः
40011551.content: सा she, तस्य महाकपेः Hanuman's, कायम् body, वर्धमानम् growing, उद्वीक्ष्य after observing, पातालान्तरसन्निभम् like the depth of the underworld, वक्त्रम् mouth, प्रसारयामास distended.

40011551.author: Translation
40011551.content: Observing the body of Hanuman growing in size, Simhika started distending her mouth wide like the depth of the underworld.

40011552.author: पदार्थः
40011552.content: घनराजीव like a mass of heavy clouds, गर्जन्ती  roaring, वानरम् that vanara, समभिद्रवत् ran towards him, ततः then, मेधावी intelligent, महाकपिः Hanuman, तस्याः her, विवृतम् opened, कायमात्रम् body alone, सुमहत् enormous, मुखम् mouth, मर्माणि च vatal parts, सः he, ददर्श saw.

40011552.author: Translation
40011552.content: Roaring like a heavy mass of clouds, Simhika chased Hanuman. Intelligent Hanuman observed her enormous mouth and noticed her vital parts.

40011553.author: पदार्थः
40011553.content: घनराजीव like a mass of heavy clouds, गर्जन्ती  roaring, वानरम् that vanara, समभिद्रवत् ran towards him, ततः then, मेधावी intelligent, महाकपिः Hanuman, तस्याः her, विवृतम् opened, कायमात्रम् body alone, सुमहत् enormous, मुखम् mouth, मर्माणि च vatal parts, सः he, ददर्श saw.

40011553.author: Translation
40011553.content: Roaring like a heavy mass of clouds, Simhika chased Hanuman. Intelligent Hanuman observed her enormous mouth and noticed her vital parts.

40011554.author: पदार्थः
40011554.content: महाबलः strong one, वज्रसंहननः of thunderboltlike physique, सः कपिः that vanara, आत्मानम् himself, मुहुः once again, संक्षिप्य contracted, तस्याः her, विवृते open, वक्त्रे in the mouth, निष्पपात entered.

40011554.author: Translation
40011554.content: Hanuman, the vanara whose physique was as hard as thunderbolt suddenly contracted once again and entered her opened mouth.

40011555.author: पदार्थः
40011555.content: सिद्धचारणाः siddhas and charanas, तस्याः her, आस्ये in the mouth, निमज्जन्तम् drowning in, पर्वणि on fullmoon day, राहुणा by Rahu, ग्रस्यमानम् being seized, पूर्णम् full, चन्द्रं यथा like the Moon, ददृशुः saw.

40011555.author: Translation
40011555.content: The siddhas and charanas who were watching his performance of drowning in her mouth were amazed as though the moon is seized by Rahu on a fullmoon night.

40011556.author: पदार्थः
40011556.content: ततः thay, वानरः vanara, तीक्ष्णैः with sharp, नखैः with nails, तस्याः her, मर्माणि private vital parts, उत्कृत्य after tearing, अथ then, मनः सम्पातविक्रमः  with the speed of mind in action, वेगेन quickly, उत्पपात rushed out.

40011556.author: Translation
40011556.content: The vanara who had the speed of mind tore her vital parts with his sharp nails and rushed out quickly before she closed her mouth.

40011557.author: पदार्थः
40011557.content: आत्मवान् selfcontrolled, सः he, कपिप्रवरः great monkey, ताम् her, दृष्ट्वा च after seeing, धृत्या च with firmness of mind, दाक्षिण्येन with ingenuity, निपात्य thrown down, पुनः again, वेगात् rapidly, ववृधे grew in size.

40011557.author: Translation
40011557.content: Selfcontrolled Hanuman, the great monkey acting with firmness of mind and ingenuity threw her down and once again rapidly grew in size.

40011558.author: पदार्थः
40011558.content: सा that, हनुमता by Hanuman, हृतहृत्  heart torn, विधुरा  miserable, अम्भसि into water, पपात fell down, वानरेण by vanara, आशु instantly, हताम् killed, पतिताम् dropped, वीक्ष्य  seeing, आकाशाचारीणि  moving in the sky, भूतानि beings, तम् him, प्लवगोत्तमम् best of vanaras, ऊचुः addressed.

40011558.author: Translation
40011558.content: Heart torn asunder and killed by Hanuman, miserable Simhika instantly fell into the sea water. Observing it, the beings who ranged the sky said to the foremost of vanaras:

40011559.author: पदार्थः
40011559.content: प्लवतां वर O great jumper, अद्य  to day, त्वया by you, महत्  great, सत्त्वम् creature, हतम् is destroyed, भीमम् fierce, कर्म action, कृतम् done, अभिप्रेतम् intention, अर्थम् aim, अरिष्टम् unobstructed, साधय you fulfill

40011559.author: Translation
40011559.content: "O great jumper a great deed has been done by you today in killing that fierce creature. O great monkey fulfil your mission without any obstruction.

40011560.author: पदार्थः
40011560.content: वानरेन्द्र O lord of vanara, यस्य in whom, धृतिः fortitude, दृष्टिः vision, मतिः intelligence, दाक्ष्यम् dexterity, एतानि these, चत्वारि four, तव यथा as in you, स: he, कर्मसु in missions, न सीदति will not get lost.

40011560.author: Translation
40011560.content: "O lord of vanaras he in whom these four qualities, fortitude, vision, intelligence and dexterity exist as in you will achieve his mission and not get lost".

40011561.author: पदार्थः
40011561.content: पूज्यः a venerable one, सः कपिः that monkey, तैः by them, सम्भावितः honoured, प्रतिपन्नप्रयोजनः achieved the objective, आकाशम् sky, आविश्य having ascended,      पन्नगाशानवत् like Garuda, जगाम went.

40011561.author: Translation
40011561.content: Honoured by them the venerable monkey went ascending into the sky like Garuda to achieve the objective.

40011562.author: पदार्थः
40011562.content: प्राप्तभूयिष्ठपारः on reaching the other side of the shore, सर्वतः all over, प्रतिलोकयन्  looked around, योजनानाम् of yojanas, शतस्य of a hundred, अन्ते at the end of, वनराजिम् rows of forest trees, ददर्श saw.

40011562.author: Translation
40011562.content: On reaching the other side of the shore crossing  a hundred yojanas, he saw rows of forest trees.

40011563.author: पदार्थः
40011563.content: शाखामृगश्रेष्ठः best among the animals that jump on branches, monkeys, पतन्नेन onwhile yet on air, विविधद्रुमभूषितम् adorned with several kinds of beautiful trees, द्वीपम् island, मलयोपवनानि gardens bordering Malaya mountain, ददर्श च also saw.

40011563.author: Translation
40011563.content: Hanuman, the best among jumpers, even while in air he saw an island adorned with many trees, also gardens adjacent to Malaya mountain.
